memoryHook: Etwaig: whatever may etwa (perhaps) come up.

options: only before nouns, in formal writing
quiz.answer: only before nouns, in formal writing

goodToKnow: Etwaig means possible or any that may arise, used before nouns in formal and business German: etwaige Rückfragen (any queries), etwaige Mängel (any defects). You'll find it in contracts, terms and conditions and official letters. In speech, people say eventuell, möglich or einfach falls: Falls Sie Fragen haben... It comes from etwa (about, perhaps). Note: German eventuell means possibly, not eventually.
